title: Apply v1 — the company people apply to
music: none yet (owner will send a TikTok sound after the first cut)

sections.text: They'll call your business idea unrealistic, then apply to a company that started as somebody's idea.
Since you were a kid it's been one plan. Good grades, college, get hired, climb, retire. Nobody asks what you want to build.
Say you're starting something and suddenly everyone's an expert. Too risky. Be realistic. Get a real job.
Your first idea might flop. So might your second. But the safe route isn't guaranteed either. Companies lay people off every year.
Now picture the people who laughed, scrolling job listings, and the company hiring is yours.
You spent years learning how to apply to companies. What if yours is the one people apply to?
